programs.title: American Loggers
programs.desc: In this series, we meet the Pelletier family - nine brothers who have to deal with the harsh nature, equipment failures and everyday squabbles so that their company, Pelletier Inc., can function smoothly.This company is the embodiment of the American dream.50 years ago, Gerald Pelletier founded it on his own, with one truck and $100.Currently, his sons run a large corporation that employs dozens of workers and uses hundreds of machines to cut down forests on thousands of hectares.
